info.title: UN Transcripts API
info.description:
Public, read-only API for UN Web TV meeting records and automatically generated transcripts.

Meeting URLs use human-readable slugs derived from official UN document symbols (S/PV.10175 → `sc/10175`, A/79/PV.21 → `ga/79/21`). Append `.json` or `.txt` to any meeting page URL to get the same content as data. Videos without a document symbol are addressable at `/{locale}/asset/{asset_id}`.

Citing a moment: every meeting page URL accepts `?t=<m:ss>`, `?t=<h:mm:ss>`, or `?t=<seconds>` (e.g. `/en/sc/10175?t=1:23:45`), which opens the page with the video seeked to that moment and the matching statement highlighted. The sentence timings in a transcript's `.json` (`start`/`end`, in seconds) are exactly what you put in `?t=`, so any statement can be turned into a citation link. Generated links use clock timestamps; malformed values such as `?t=90s` are ignored.

Transcripts available through this API are created by using automatic speech recognition and are not official records nor official documents of the United Nations. Official records and official documents are available on the Official Document System of the United Nations; the verbatim (PV) or summary (SR) document for a meeting can be fetched via `GET /api/pv`.

get.description: Paginated list of meetings within the last 365 days, newest first. Supports full-text search and filtering. Page size is 250.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: One of the six official UN languages.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search meeting titles and metadata. Minimum 2 characters — a shorter non-empty q is a 400. Add `ft=1` to also search inside transcript content.

parameters.name: ft
parameters.description: Set to 1 (with q) to also search INSIDE transcript statements. Content-matched meetings are added to the results and carry a `matches` object with speaker, snippet, and a `?t=` deeplink per hit. Terms containing digits (L.73, 2735, S/2026/243) match as exact fragments — robust for document symbols; word terms use stemmed full-text search; quoted phrases work. Searches the URL locale's transcript track; only meetings with a completed transcript are covered. `ft=1` without a valid q is a 400.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by WebTV category name.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Filter to a single date (YYYY-MM-DD). Combining it with from/to is not rejected but intersects the two constraints, which is rarely what you want — pass either date or from/to.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive end of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default date_desc). There is no relevance mode — content searches (ft=1) come back date-ordered too, by design. An unrecognized value is a 400.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number (default 1). Results come in pages of 250; page with 1, 2, 3, … A non-positive or non-integer value is a 400.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Filter by available document type. `transcript` = has an automatic transcript; `pv` = has an official verbatim record; `sr` = has an official summary record. Repeating it matches ANY of the given types, not all (`text=transcript&text=pv` = has a transcript OR a verbatim record). Use `text=transcript` to exclude meetings with no content to read.

parameters.name: xlang
parameters.description: Set to 1 to include transcripts that exist only in other languages.

400.description: A known parameter was malformed — a bad date/from/to, an unknown sort or text value, q shorter than 2 chars, ft=1 without q, or a non-positive page.

get.description: Same data as `meetings.json` in a compact, LLM-friendly plain-text table. Accepts the same query parameters.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: One of the six official UN languages.

get.summary: Get a single meeting and its transcript (JSON)
get.description:
Returns the meeting metadata and transcript for a slug derived from a UN document symbol. The response has one of three shapes depending on transcript availability (completed, in-progress, or absent — see the schema).

`slug` may contain slashes (it is a multi-segment path). Examples:
- `sc/10175` — Security Council (S/PV.10175)
- `ga/79/21` — General Assembly plenary (A/79/PV.21)
- `ga/c1/79/21` — GA First Committee
- `hrc/55/12` — Human Rights Council
- `ecosoc/2024/30` — ECOSOC
- `asset/k1a2b3c4` — permalink for videos without a document symbol

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: One of the six official UN languages.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Meeting slug derived from a UN document symbol (may contain slashes), or `asset/{asset_id}` for videos without a symbol.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Transcript language to return (defaults to the URL locale).

200.description: The meeting and (if available) its transcript.

404.description: Unknown locale, invalid slug, or video not found.

get.summary: Get meeting transcript data by Kaltura player ID
get.description: Returns the same response as the asset/citation `.json` route, looked up by the stable Kaltura player ID (`videos.kaltura_id`). The response still advertises the canonical citation or asset URL.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: One of the six official UN languages.

parameters.name: kalturaId
parameters.description: Stable Kaltura player ID stored as videos.kaltura_id.

200.description: The meeting and (if available) its transcript.

404.description: Malformed/unknown player ID or removed video.

get.summary: Get a single meeting transcript (plain text)
get.description: Plain-text rendering of the transcript with speaker headers and timecodes. See the `.json` variant for the slug grammar.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: One of the six official UN languages.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Meeting slug derived from a UN document symbol (may contain slashes), or `asset/{asset_id}` for videos without a symbol.

404.description: Unknown locale, invalid slug, or video not found.

get.summary: List audio language tracks for a video
get.description: Returns all six UN languages with a flag for whether an audio track exists and the current transcript status for each.

parameters.name: kalturaId
parameters.description: Kaltura player ID (the `kaltura_id` field).

get.summary: Resolve a recording and its transcript availability
get.description: Lightweight, public CORS endpoint. Pass exactly one identifier. Asset and player IDs are unique; canonical entry IDs may return multiple matches because several WebTV assets can redirect to the same Kaltura media. Valid unknown identifiers return an empty matches array and a safe Transcripts landing-page generationUrl.

parameters.name: assetId
parameters.description: UN Web TV asset ID, including any slash.

parameters.name: webtvUrl
parameters.description: Full https://webtv.un.org/.../asset/... URL.

parameters.name: kalturaId
parameters.description: Stable Kaltura player ID (1_...).

parameters.name: entryId
parameters.description: Canonical Kaltura entry ID fallback; may return multiple matches.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Locale used to build page and generation URLs.

200.description: Resolution result, including zero or more matches.

get.description: Fetches the official UN verbatim (PV) or summary (SR) record PDF for a document symbol, parses it to structured JSON, and caches it. This is the authoritative record (transcripts are not).

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: UN document symbol, e.g. S/PV.10175.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Document language (default en).

404.description: Document not found or not available.

get.description: Pings the database. 200 when healthy, 503 otherwise.

count.description: Total matching statements in this meeting's transcript.

affiliation.description: ISO alpha-3 country code or short affiliation label.

affiliation_full.description: Official UN country name resolved from the ISO code.

text.description: Snippet centered on the first match; ellipses mark truncation. Full statements live in jsonUrl.

pageUrl.description: Meeting page deep-linked to this moment via `?t=` — opens with the player seeked and the statement highlighted.

matches.description: Transcript-content hits for this meeting (present only with `ft=1` when the transcript matched).

totalIncludingOther.description: Total ignoring the locale filter (see the xlang param).

statementTotal.description: With `ft=1`: matching statements across all result meetings.

id.description: UN Web TV asset ID (the DB primary key).

metadata.description: Structured metadata harvested from the UN Web TV page.

start.description: Start time of the statement in seconds (its first sentence).

pageUrl.description: Meeting page deep-linked to this statement via `?t=` — cite a statement without rebuilding the URL from `start`.

items.description: A substantive policy topic identified across the meeting.

words.description: Per-word timing; present only when word-level timing exists.

affiliation.description: ISO alpha-3 country code or short affiliation label.

affiliation_full.description: Official UN country name resolved from the ISO code.

items.description: A substantive policy topic identified across the meeting.

MeetingResponse.description: One of three shapes depending on transcript availability: completed (full transcript), in-progress (status only), or absent (null).

code.description: ISO 639-1 code of one of the six official UN languages.

available.description: Whether an audio track exists for this language.

transcriptStatus.description: Transcription status, or null if none exists.

PvResponse.description: Parsed UN verbatim (PV) or summary (SR) record.

generationUrl.description: Exact meeting page for one match; locale landing page when unresolved or ambiguous.

DataApiError.description: Error response from the meeting data API.
